items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...she was married to one of the Lyman Brothers... [INTERVIEWEE] Simon.

ctx.x: And at the time, Fancheon of Fancheon and Marko staged the reviews there at the Alabama, because she was married to one of the Lyman Brothers. She was one of the sisters, and she married -- what was his name? Simon.
